episode_summary: In this episode, Valerie Fitzgerald shares her inspiring journey from a struggling single mother to a top luxury real estate agent in Los Angeles. She discusses the importance of overcoming fear, taking bold actions, and continuously reinventing oneself. Valerie also highlights the role of AI in modern real estate and offers actionable strategies for breaking into the luxury market.
